Past visits stay immutable; deleting owners, pets, and past visits stays out; changing a visit's date or description stays out. (C) Reopen more widely, e.g. also allow amending a visit or cancelling past visits. RECOMMENDATION: B. It matches the stated problem (wrong pet or wrong day on a booking not yet attended) and keeps the forward-only-correction principle for history.
